conditions: Every fragment retains source, time, location, and knowledge boundary.
Direct observation, quoted claim, and player inference remain distinct.
Repetition of one source does not count as corroboration.
effect: Pieces can accumulate into a stronger account without any single page, recording, resident, or generated summary becoming omniscient by default.
failure_boundary: If one fragment silently resolves events outside its source boundary, the mystery is being asserted rather than reconstructed.
